completed2026Moves.analysis: Reunites an elite 6'7" interior disruptor with Nick Bosa and the Wide-9 system; immediately stabilizes interior run defense and A/B-gap pass rush.
High-motor penetrating 3-technique who carried the interior pass-rush workload during Bosa's Weeks 3–7 absence.

topNeeds.epaContext: With Brandon Aiyuk, Deebo Samuel Sr., Mike Evans, and Christian Kirk Out—and Ricky Pearsall + rookie De'Zhaun Stribling on IR—adding a low-cost veteran Z/X separator supports Brandin Cooks, Jordan Watkins, Jacob Cowing & Demarcus Robinson.
Protecting a 6-1 NFC contention run requires veteran insurance behind Trent Williams (age 38) and Colton McKivitz for cold-weather January games.
Special teams + dime package coverage vs. NFC elite TEs/slot WRs (Detroit, Philadelphia, LA Rams).

tieredRumors.sources: Nick Wagoner, Matt Barrows, Adam Schefter
tieredRumors.summary: After acquiring DeForest Buckner and getting Nick Bosa back healthy for Week 9, SF prefers preserving 2027 rollover cap unless a seller eats base salary on a veteran WR.
Brandon Aiyuk met with 49ers brass Friday seeking reinstatement; both sides working toward a structured resolution rather than contentious grievances.
Any pre-Tuesday move is projected to stay under $3.5M in remaining 2026 cap charge to protect ~$25M+ carryover into 2027.

seedPathCards.pathSummary: At 6-1 (3-0 NFC West, 4-1 NFC), SF holds strong leverage in the NFC #1 seed race across its 10 remaining regular-season games, anchored by upcoming NFC matchups.
Sitting at 6-1 overall and 3-0 inside the NFC West (+58 (197 PF / 139 PA)), protecting division head-to-head tiebreakers keeps the NFC West crown at 97.7%.
With 6 wins banked through 7 games (4-1 conference record), reaching 10+ total wins across the remaining 10 games yields >92% playoff berth equity.
